# CV-20 — Custom emoji

> Branch `t/maciej/cv-20-custom-emoji-2` (merged with the build head 4d66dcba) · status: built, migration applied to the local stack 2026-10-16
> Migration: `supabase/migrations/20261016235000_chat_v2_custom_emoji.sql` · applied to the local stack: yes (2026-10-16, anchors re-checked against the live bodies after CV-22 and CV-14; a second run is a no-op). Dry-run inside a rolled-back transaction with every SQL test: no new failures (the local stack's known grant failures in access_check, comments and others are the same with and without it). Every redefined function is cut from its live body at apply time (`pg_temp.recut`): if CV-22 or CV-14 changed an expected line, the migration stops and names the function.

## Delivered against the row

- **The switch:** `workspace_chat_caps.add_emoji` (on for admins and members, off for viewers; new workspaces too via `share_seed_workspace`), in `chat_has_cap`, `chat_caps_set` (a viewer's stays off) and `chat_caps_get` (whole rows); `CHAT_CAPABILITIES` + `CHAT_CAP_DEFAULTS`; `ChatRights.addEmoji`. CV-15's role editor row now shows by itself.
- **One reaction key:** `reactions__key_ok` takes `:name:` through `reactions__custom_key_pattern()` (shape only; it backs a CHECK); `reactions__key_canonical` leaves a `:name:` alone (its digits aren't keycaps). Client `isReactionKey` / `canonicalReactionKey` the same; the shared corpus in `chat_reactions.test.sql` gained custom keys (and `:party:` is now a key).
- **Table `chat_custom_emoji`:** the brief's columns; names 2–32 of a–z 0–9 - _ with a letter, unique per workspace among live rows, never a standard shortcode (`chat__emoji_name_reserved`, Emojibase's GitHub set, drift-gated against the JSON); members read (not the plan); soft delete; published; writes only through ops.
- **Bucket `chat-emoji`** (private, PNG/GIF/WebP, 256 KB). Images live under an **upload slot the server mints** for one person in one workspace (`chat_op_custom_emoji_begin`, an hour, at most 20 open): `<workspace>/<slot>.<ext>` and `<workspace>/<slot>.poster.png`. Uploading needs your own open slot in that folder plus the switch and the plan; reading needs membership; no rule lets anyone change or delete an image.
- **Ops:** `chat_op_custom_emoji_add(slot, name, mime, width, height, bytes, animated)` — the paths come from the slot; both images must be in it, uploaded by you, stored with the type and size described; 128 px, 256 KB, 500 per workspace, the name rules; consumes the slot. `chat_op_custom_emoji_remove(id)` — its adder or an admin, a soft delete. Activity `chat.emoji_add` / `chat.emoji_remove`. No op takes a person; a key gets nothing.
- **Reactions:** `chat_op_react` and `comments_op_react` (live bodies) add a `:name:` only while it's live in the message's or comment's workspace; taking one back always works.
- **Erasure:** `account_erase_workspace_data` sets `created_by` to null (count `custom_emoji_unattributed`) and drops the person's upload slots.
- **Client:** `src/features/chat/emoji/` — model, upload preparation (bytes sniffed, name/type must agree, never SVG, still images scaled to 128 px as PNG, animated ones refused over 128 px or 256 KB and stored as they are, a still frame drawn), the shared store (one copy per workspace, own Realtime channel, signed links in batches), the glyph (an `<img>`, still frame until hover, never with reduced motion; a removed or unknown one reads `:name:`), the picker's workspace section first, `:` menu custom first, message bodies, reaction chips and quick rows in chat and on task/note comments, comment bodies, Settings → Chat → Custom emoji (who added each, ⋯ → Remove for the adder or an admin, Add emoji dialog). The kit's `Reactions` takes a `glyph` renderer (story `CustomKeys`).

## Finishing pass (2026-10-16)

- **Export:** `extraFiles` wired (`src/features/chat/emoji/export-files.ts`): the live emoji you added go in as `chat/files/emoji/<name>.<ext>`.
- **Erasure:** `account-erasure.ts` also removes the owned workspaces' `chat-emoji/<ws>/…` images (a missing bucket is nothing to remove); in other workspaces the emoji stay, `created_by` → null.
- **Review fixes:** links re-signed every 10 min check while open and a failed signing retried; a glyph whose link failed draws again once re-signed; adds landing during a read are kept; a comment's `:name:` resolves in the comment's workspace; the `:` menu stays open through `_` and `-`; a status emoji can't be a `:name:` (`user_statuses__parts`); the add dialog's name from the file no longer overwrites a typed one.
- **Proven:** `bun run db:test chat` (24 files), `bun run verify`, `tests/chat-emoji.spec.ts` pass.

## Agent's choices (deferred to by Maciej: confirmed for building, may be reconsidered)

- **Name rule is 2–32 with a letter, no `+`** · agent · the intersection of the brief's `[a-z0-9_-]{1,32}` and the text grammar (markup-v2), so every name also draws in a message · rejected: 1-character names that would never draw.
- **Images under a server-minted upload slot, not a content hash; no sharing of identical images** · agent · nobody can take or prepare another person's path, and the server can't check a hash · rejected: `<sha256>` paths with dedupe (the brief's sketch).
- **`chat_op_custom_emoji_add` takes the slot, not paths** · agent · the server names the paths · rejected: the brief's `(ws, name, path, poster_path, …)` signature.
- **A JPEG is accepted in the picker and stored as the PNG it becomes** · agent · stills are re-drawn at 128 px anyway; the stored types stay PNG/GIF/WebP as the spec says · rejected: storing JPEG.
- **An APNG counts as animated** · agent · browsers animate it, so it needs the still frame.
- **"Add emoji…" in the picker opens Settings → Chat** · agent · one place to add · rejected: a second upload dialog in the composer.
- **Reaction keys up to 32 emoji code points, or a `:name:` up to 34 characters** · agent · each arm keeps its own length.
- **Re-sending "on" for a removed emoji you already reacted with is refused** · agent · harmless; the reaction stays and can be taken back.
- **The export carries only the emoji you added, and outside the chat file budget** · agent · the account export is your data; at most 500 × 256 KB · rejected: every live emoji of the workspace.
- **Removed emoji's images stay in storage** · agent · soft delete; the purge job doesn't clear them yet.

## Gotchas (area: supabase)

- A policy may not call `chat_is_workspace_member(ws, auth.uid())` directly (access_check's rule): wrap it in a caller-only SECURITY DEFINER helper (`chat_emoji__readable`).
- `storage.objects` refuses a direct DELETE in SQL ("use the Storage API"); a test of "nobody deletes" sees that error, not `ok 0`.
- The `chat_realtime` publication test lists chat tables exactly; a new published chat table updates it.
